report:
Reviewed the complete claim: badges must open canonical anchor pages; reverse context links must locate Markdown or Sage definitions; definition permalinks must survive independently of the anchor-page URL. The ordinary spec.rs association implements chapter_replacements with a definition id separate from its relative anchor-page href, reparses expanded text, and uses add_chapter_text to retain Markdown #qualified-name and Sage #anchor:qualified-name context URLs. Captured book renderer context confirms the reverse link consumes context_url.

All four ordinary tests were inspected in full. generated_anchor_pages_join_namespaces_claims_implementations_tests_and_reviews invokes the preprocessor and asserts both the definition-to-anchor href and ../../meta.html#meta.foo return path. sage_anchor_links_retain_the_containing_entity_and_exact_prose checks Sage entity ownership, exact context URL, rendered definition id, anchor-page href and parent-frame target. badges_open_rule_pages_and_keep_definition_permalinks_after_expansion checks retained id, canonical badge/reference links and separate context_url after preprocessing shifts text. sage_prose_rules_have_precise_spans_model_owners_and_cross_source_references checks precise definition/content spans, declaration/member/query owners and Sage context URL. Captured fixture helpers create actual source inventories and invoke the real preprocessor; assertions are visible in test bodies. A regression dropping the definition id or routing badges to their context URL would fail these assertions.

The explicit todo::anchor_pages_and_definition_context_links remains deferred. Its comment identifies the complete navigation scenario; the prerequisite to retiring it is full authored/rendered navigation integration establishing precise return behavior for both Markdown and Sage, including permalink preservation. Existing structural and preprocessing assertions do not establish browser navigation through the Sage location routing. This justified inherited TODO accounts for that remaining coverage and is not treated as implemented or as a passing behavioral test. There are no N/A associations.

Verified exact byte matches of current spec.rs and spec_plan.rs to the historical reviewed sources. Inspected book.rs and spec.rs deltas: review setup now uses per-anchor start/record and accepted/requested/unfinished state assertions; claim extraction now selects the claim fragment. Navigation assertions remain intact. Reassessed the supplied historical rationale against current claim and complete evidence rather than transferring its verdict mechanically. Additional relied-on fixture and renderer context was captured with review read.

Execution: this reviewer ran review start/read and source comparison commands, then review record; no behavioral tests or build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator separately reports 321 passing functional sage-meta tests and a successful root cargo build. Acceptance preserves the explicit TODO and requests no source changes.
